asked.item: Search the Inspiration database from Claude through the Blotato MCP server
Doing the search the way they do in the web app

verdict.reason: S8 says the MCP tool catalog has no Inspiration Database search tool, and S4 and S5 describe searching in the web app.

steps.text: The MCP tool catalog does not expose an Inspiration Database search tool, so Claude can't search it for you that way.
To search Inspiration, use the web app, where you can search topics or find a creator.
In the web app you can also apply filters or shuffle results.
